question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_composition AS (
  SELECT im.interest_id, 
         im.month_year, 
         im.composition,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC) as rn
  FROM interest_metrics im
  WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_categories AS (
  SELECT imi.interest_name, mc.month_year, mc.composition
  FROM max_composition mc
  JOIN interest_map imi ON mc.interest_id = imi.id
  WHERE mc.rn = 1
),
top_10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_categories ORDER BY composition DESC LIMIT 10
),
bottom_10 AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_categories ORDER BY composition ASC LIMIT 10
)
SELECT * FROM top_10
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM bottom_10
